import { WindowManager } from "@mediar-ai/terminator";
import * as Terminator from "@mediar-ai/terminator";
import { writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";

async function main() {
  try {
    // 1. Get the current application
    const app = await desktop.getCurrentApplication();
    const processId = app.processId();

    // 2. Get the application's window information
    const manager = new WindowManager();
    const windowInfo = await manager.getTopmostWindowForPid(processId);

    if (!windowInfo) {
      throw new Error(`No window found for process ID ${processId}`);
    }

    const process = windowInfo.processName;
    const title = windowInfo.title;

    console.log("Process:", process);
    console.log("Title:", title);

    // 3. Retrieve the complete UI tree
    const result = desktop.getWindowTreeResult(process, title, {
      formatOutput: true,
      propertyMode: Terminator.PropertyLoadingMode.Complete,
      treeOutputFormat: Terminator.TreeOutputFormat.CompactYaml,
    });

    // 5. Save valid, readable JSON
    const outputPath = path.resolve("ui-tree.json");

    await writeFile(outputPath, JSON.stringify(result, null, 2), "utf8");

    console.log("Full UI tree saved to:", outputPath);
    console.log("Total indexed elements:", result.elementCount);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "Error:",
      error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
    );
  }
}

await main();
